slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video, autoplay + muted + playsInline, cover-cropped behind all foreground content. Spec is emphatic: render at 100% opacity with NO dark overlay/scrim, so the footage itself carries the section's tone. Pick logistics/transport footage (the brand is 'targo') that is dark enough on its own for white headline + nav text to stay legible without a gradient. Currently a CloudFront placeholder mp4 (d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/...c4b2f2ea... .mp4) — replace with a brand-owned loop.

Brand logo lockup in the top-left of the navbar: an abstract symbol plus the 'targo' wordmark, delivered as a white SVG. Sits on the unscrimmed video so it must read at small navbar height against arbitrary footage. Supply as a single-color, transparent-background SVG; to stay tintable in the white-on-dark scheme deliver it as a currentColor / fill-inheriting glyph rather than a baked white hex.

Single Phone icon (lucide-react <Phone>) placed inside the bottom-left 'Book a Free Consultation' glass card's call button. Stroke icon that inherits currentColor; sized to the button label. Swap for the brand's own phone/contact glyph if not using lucide-react.

Single global typeface: the Rubik family. Headlines are bold, UPPERCASE, with tight letter-spacing (approx -4% / -0.04em) at ~64px desktop and ~42px mobile; the same family carries nav links, both CTAs ('Get Started', 'Book a Call'/'Contact Us'), and the consultation card copy. Swap with the brand display sans; the uppercase + -4% tracking headline metrics are tuned to Rubik Bold.

mechanic: A single full-viewport black hero playing an unscrimmed autoplaying object-cover looping background video, with a left-aligned upper-third bold-uppercase headline + clipped-corner red 'Get Started' CTA, a top nav bar (white logo, links, clipped-corner red 'Contact Us' button), and a bottom-left liquid-glass 'Book a Free Consultation' card (backdrop-blur(40px) saturate(180%) + diagonal shine + inner shadow); the only motion is the looping video plus CSS hover transitions (no scroll/entrance animation).
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS single hero section; the Rubik font family loaded as a webfont; clipped-corner buttons built with CSS clip-path (a 10-12px diagonal cut on the top-right and bottom-left corners); glassmorphism via backdrop-filter blur/saturate; Phone icon from lucide-react; responsive via Tailwind breakpoints (headline 64px->42px, padding 64px->32px). No animation library and the logo is an inline/asset SVG.
reskinNotes: Brand red #EE3F2C is the only accent and is applied directly to the two clipped-corner buttons; the clip-path corner-cut geometry is a fixed inline style, so a different button silhouette means editing CSS, not a token. The liquid-glass card stacks several baked values (blur 40px, saturate 180%, 1px white border at 12% opacity, a diagonal white-to-transparent shine gradient, and an inner box-shadow) that are visually tuned to a dark video behind them — over a light or busy brand video the glass and the unscrimmed white headline text can lose contrast (there is no overlay scrim to fall back on). Headline metrics (uppercase, ~-4% letter-spacing, 64px/42px) and the compact 'scaled-down' padding (64px->32px) are tuned to Rubik Bold and the specific copy 'Swift and Simple Transport', so a wider face or longer headline will reflow the upper-third block. All copy (nav labels Home/About/Contact Us, both 'Contact Us' and 'Get Started' buttons, 'Book a Free Consultation' / 'Book a Call', brand name 'targo') is hardcoded in the markup.
